summary: Backend auth + multi-user isolation testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_auth_fisiomanager.py (21 tests). 19/21 passing. Verified: 401 on all protected endpoints without/invalid Bearer token; register (201) + duplicate 409 + wrong password 401; /auth/me + /auth/logout invalidation; Google invalid session_id → 401; per-user data isolation for patients/appointments/settings (user B still sees 50€ default after A set 60€); user B cannot GET/PUT/DELETE user A's patients or GET/download A's invoice (404); voice /plan requires auth and is scoped to user; full auth'd invoice flow with user A in April 2026 = 527.0€ (7 × 1.5h @ 50€ + 2€ bollo) with xlsx & PDF generated per user. Two backend bugs found: (1) POST /api/auth/apple with malformed identity_token returns 500 instead of 401 (uncaught jwt.DecodeError in _verify_apple). (2) POST /api/invoices/confirm returns 500 for a user with a single appointment because invoice_generator.py:181 tries to write .value on a MergedCell while clearing leftover template rows. Blocked the per-user 'both users get invoice #1' assertion for the 1-appt case.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when confirming an invoice with a small number of appointments (n=1 tested). Root cause: invoice_generator.py:181 does `ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None` inside the leftover-rows loop, but the template has merged cells in that range, and openpyxl raises `AttributeError: 'MergedCell' object attribute 'value' is read-only`. Fix: skip MergedCell instances (e.g., check `isinstance(cell, openpyxl.cell.cell.MergedCell)` or unmerge those ranges before clearing). Works for n>=7 (Verdi flow) because DETAIL_START+n bypasses the clearing loop.

Returns 500 (not 401) when identity_token is a malformed JWT. `jwt.get_unverified_header(...)` raises `jwt.exceptions.DecodeError: Invalid header padding` in auth.py:_verify_apple before the try/except. Fix: wrap the header/JWK lookup in try/except and raise HTTPException(401) on jwt.PyJWTError (or wrap the whole verifier). Not exploitable but leaks stacktrace and fails 401 contract.

minor.issue: Response Settings.id is set to user_id (the authenticated user's opaque id). It is not a MongoDB _id and no user_id field is leaked, but exposing internal user_id via `id` is inconsistent with other resources (patients/appointments/invoices use their own UUIDs). Consider using a stable value like 'default' or omitting `id` entirely for the singleton.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (Apple 500): auth.py:_verify_apple invokes jwt.get_unverified_header(identity_token) at the top of the function. If the token isn't a base64url-encoded JWT ('not.a.valid.jwt' in test), pyjwt raises jwt.exceptions.DecodeError('Invalid header padding') which is NOT caught by the later `except jwt.PyJWTError` around jwt.decode. Wrap the whole function or the header/JWK-selection block in try/except jwt.PyJWTError → raise HTTPException(401, 'Invalid Apple token'). Bug 2 (Invoice 500 for n<7): invoice_generator.generate_xlsx iterates rows DETAIL_START+n .. TEMPLATE_LAST_DETAIL and writes None into every cell (line 181). The XLSX template has merged cells in that band; openpyxl forbids .value assignment on MergedCell. Fix pattern: `cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col); if not isinstance(cell, MergedCell): cell.value = None` — or explicitly `ws.unmerge_cells(...)` for the leftover band before clearing. Reproduce: register user, create 1 appointment in a month, POST /api/invoices/confirm → 500. With 7 appointments the clearing loop is skipped (range is empty) so the previously-passing 527€ flow masks the defect.
